steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: 'Dr. {@nickname}?'

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You're saying that... the two of you have known each other for a long, long time?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm just a bit nervous. After all, you've known the Doctor for longer than you've known me, and I would like to leave a good first impression.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: There's just one thing though. Kal'tsit, you have some concerns about the kind of person the 'Doctor' is now, right? It's written all over your face.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Let me find out as well, Kal'tsit. I'm really curious, what sort of person is that 'Doctor' who is so closely connected to your past?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: How should I go about it...? Meeting this Doctor, exchanging pleasantries, connecting the Doctor to myself and the Sarkaz... These are all questions I have to answer for myself.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: My opinion... can influence you as well, yes?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: So, Kal'tsit, take me to see the Doctor, won't you?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Good work, Scout.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: It was just a recon mission, part of my job.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Hmm... Where are Kal'tsit and the Doctor?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: The conference room... Is something wrong?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Our spy in the Military Council has returned our intelligence. They don't intend to give us any breathing room...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Unfortunately.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: A spy... Are you talking about that Vampire noble? Your Majesty, I believe she only answers to the Prince of Blood, and is untrustworthy.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Most of them are nothing more than speculators looking out after their own interest. Unless forced by the situation, I doubt she would even enter the war...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Of course. I understand your concerns, Scout.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But at least for now, she won't lie to me. She hasn't worked up the courage for that yet.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Kal'tsit? Doctor? Are you two busy?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your Majesty. Is your meeting over?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes, but the results aren't exactly a cause for celebration.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Am I interrupting your work? By the way, since I rarely get out of my meetings before noon, would you like to have lunch with me, Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's too early.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Huh? Oh... I suppose it is.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, I meant to say, you're a lot earlier than usual.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's hard to imagine that the people in the Chairman's office would just let you go that easily, unless the result is so bad that there's nothing to talk about.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if that is the case, you... still did come a bit too early.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I guess so... but we anticipated this current situation... a long time ago, didn't we?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So, the discussions didn't go smoothly. I guess the situation is worse now, to the point where talks are about to break down.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What happened?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The Military Council has gained support, and our information channels throughout Kazdel are shrinking.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Babel will likely come under siege in the fall.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Some of the Sarkaz betrayed us, which is to be expected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Babel is not fully prepared yet...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Sorry, Kal'tsit. By the looks of things, we won't keep it together that long.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The King of the Nachzehrer and the rest of the royal court...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: They've only put forth a more demanding request. Don't worry, Kal'tsit, they're just targeting me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But... we no longer have the leeway to deal with more mistrust.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Theresa.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What is it, Doctor? Ah... Right, I haven't formally solicited your advice yet, and it would be unbecoming of me to start giving orders rashly.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Doctor, it seems we'll need to get a bit further away from Kazdel. This calls for a full relocation, or in other words, a retreat.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Do you have a second opinion?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: This might be the only option.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: If possible... I would have liked to give everyone more options. But we're out of time.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The Military Council's ideas are both too heavy-handed and direct, and I stood firmly opposed to their ideology. But to prevent Kazdel from making unnecessary sacrifices, we'll have to leave, temporarily.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I believe— I truly believe, that we share the same heart, and the same blood flows through us. But even blood can be separated and transfused, and I don't know when we'll be able to merge again.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: At least for now, separating is the least damaging option.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Every Sarkaz has a desire to follow her beliefs. I can feel your convictions, and there will be many Sarkaz following you.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: But I will not help you make a decision. I can only bear witness.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes. That's the best arrangement in front of us so far, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Alright then, without further ado, the two of you should pack up and get ready to set out!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: How much can we take with us?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Unfortunately, not much. We may have to abandon a large number of our facilities. Ascalon will buy us time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's more than enough, Theresa. You don't need to dispatch any more hands to help us. I'll bring the Doctor back to rendezvous with you safely.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Then we'll follow the pre-arranged plan, Kal'tsit. The person-in-charge will arrive later.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But, Doctor, Kal'tsit, I'm sorry to make you evacuate in such a hurry.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: We'll have to put the research on hold for the time being... How I hoped to see the fruits that they would bear.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I'll work hard to create a space where we can continue our research. Finally...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I believe things will take a turn for the better.
13 days later
Kazdel Border, Babel Encampment, 'Dr. {@nickname}'s Camp'

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Don't move.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: I'm not like those idiots getting themselves killed for no reason. I caught you alone.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You shouldn't be doing this, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Hah... Is that what someone in your shoes should be saying?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: I lost my patience a long time ago. Her Majesty... She even put you on a pedestal, letting you talk down to us.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: But you've done nothing for us at all! You don't understand us at all!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: You and that Feline aren't even Sarkaz. You don't belong in Kazdel.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Now you swarm around Her Majesty, using that intimate position of yours to push the 'Babel' she dreams about.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Don't make me laugh... Her Royal Majesty, Theresa, the great hero, thriving for a hundred years, she needs foreigners to direct her every move?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: I don't trust your ilk...! Outsiders who have nothing to do with us!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: You, 'Doctor,' to think that Her Majesty trusts you so much despite being an outsider, still act like a bystander. Let me hear it from you then, which side has a better chance of winning?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: The fact that you can only think of preserving your own hide—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Proves how pathetic you are.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: How dare you—

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Are you done?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Wha—

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: ...Scout... what are you doing here?!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Don't underestimate Ascalon, traitor, let alone Her Majesty.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Her Majesty chose to be a missionary of benevolence, to allow people to get a taste of the right to freedom...

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: But you used that freedom to do something vile.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You clearly know that Her Majesty respects the Doctor, and you've also heard the Doctor's public statements. This one has nothing to do with our 'civil war.'

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: But you, you took advantage of Her Majesty's kindness... and the Doctor's tolerance.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Maybe there's no need for me to judge you, traitor.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Scout!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Doctor. I'm merely doing what has to be done.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I get it, Scout.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: But he wanted answers from me.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: If he wanted to kill me, he could have done it already, instead of getting caught up in his choices.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You're still saying that now...?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Fine, you call the shots.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Let me talk to him, Scout.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Theresa won't mind.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Damn you... You want to talk reason, with a knife to my neck?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Ridiculous... *cough*... Damn it...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Why do you think Her Majesty has chosen to trust two outsiders?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Hah, haha... Why does Her Majesty trust you? It's nothing more than you using your rhetoric and silver tongue to manipulate fact and fiction.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Ridiculous, hilarious... Her Majesty, our King with her lofty ideals, is buying into this clown show!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Okay, Sarkaz... call me a clown, but I can't walk with Theresa anymore. That ship has sailed.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You think you don't trust me. It's Her Majesty you don't trust.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: What gives you the right—?!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You're getting led around by the nose.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You can't be a loyal vassal, you can't buy into her vision. All you've got is that title, 'Her Majesty', you can throw around to add weight to your choices.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Bullshit! You can talk like that about me?! You dare say that I don't believe in Her Majesty's way—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Those were your words, not mine.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: You filthy outsider, choke on your own spit—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Do you want to hear my opinion? I'll tell you, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I know for a fact that it's not my fault, or Kal'tsit's, that you lost faith in Her Majesty. You started to lose trust in her, and looked for someone else to blame.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: You talk out of your ass! If I really left Her Majesty, I would've taken your head with me!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: If it's really my fault you don't buy into Her Majesty's sermons anymore, why bother confronting me?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You're scared of Her Majesty's strength? Or are you scared you can't change Her Majesty's mind?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: You're still lost. You don't know your own destiny. But 'He' wants it.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: It doesn't matter who 'you' are. He knows that there will always be people like you, and there will always be such a bridge.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Who are you talking about?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: They awakened you, worked you up, and it's not so I could listen to your talk.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: He wants to know what Theresa says, and how I react.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I was never a part of the Council's plans.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: He needs to confirm this. Whether Theresa acquired any additional power.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Who the hell are you talking about? Dirty tricks, vague blathering, just to lure me into confessing to defection? Just to put on a show for Scout?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: No, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: —I only want you to walk out of this place alive.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Are you joking? What kind of joke is this?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: 'The one who can guide his people to survive, is the one crowned King in their hearts.'

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I recognize you, 'traitor.'

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: That night, you carried the wounded Ascalon back to the camp, and it was you who brought the final message from the fallen soldiers to inform the whole army of the location of the recon team.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: So, I'm giving you this opportunity.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Impossible... Why should I believe you?!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Take a good look at the situation, traitor.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Regardless of what the Doctor says, you have no choice but to believe it.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: No, no! Scout, don't be deceived! The purpose of releasing me is to rehabilitate these lies! I'm not going anywhere!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: You want to slander me as one of Theresis's spies?! You don't have the slightest idea what I've been through— I am—

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Your Majesty!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Doctor... are you injured?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Your Majesty, this incident broke out so quickly because I didn't notice the situation within the team.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: No, I told Scout to stand down. Otherwise, this Sarkaz might have already been executed.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Y-Your Majesty... I...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Ah... It's you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes... When I was giving my sermon, you were standing below. You are one of the many faces in that crowd.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What the Doctor said is right. You and your mercenaries have made military gains for us, but that... is not an excuse for your current actions.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Y-Your Majesty... I...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You... don't trust me? Marco?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You, who rescued so many of your compatriots and brought back information for us from the most dangerous of places. Now, you're no longer willing to trust me?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: No! No, no! I... I was just...

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: (I can't even bear to look up at her... I...)

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: (What have I said...?)

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Your Majesty.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: It seems that there won't be any use interrogating him.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: The situation is grim, and we need to evacuate imminently. We must immediately confirm whether there is any unrest with you among the team— or, if there is a Kazdel spy.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Please hand him over to Ascalon.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes... Before that, Doctor.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Can you tell me what he did to you just now?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: He didn't do anything.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: This might've been an assassination attempt, but I don't see that as the case.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Theresa, if I was to say that he is by far the most innocent one, would you believe me?

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Shrieks)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, This is no time to be cracking jokes. Scout probably doesn't see himself as a part of your skit either.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But at least this Sarkaz is indeed not on the list of spies that the captives named, Theresa.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Damned outsider! How dare you call Her Majesty by name...!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Do you hate Kal'tsit...? Do you hate the Doctor?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Just because they are not Sarkaz? Not because of what they've done, or what they will do?

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Yes, that's exactly right, Your Majesty!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: There are so many excellent people around you, so why do you insist on letting these outsiders—

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Shut your mouth!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes... I understand what you mean.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Allow me to ask one more question. Scout, what's your verdict?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I respect your judgment, but per my opinion, he should be taken into custody immediately and locked up.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: According to military law, there can be only one outcome.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Indeed, this is but one choice. We are always faced with countless choices.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: No matter what schemes or designs he may have, he will be unable to resist that desire.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This won't be the last time you see actions like this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa, if your tolerance creates further troubles, it will eventually threaten your safety.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: He simply made an unfortunate decision.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: No, Your Majesty...! P-Please, I can explain...

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: I am... Sarkaz... a Sarkaz of Kazdel...! I just couldn't bear the thought... of you and Babel being so far away from Kazdel!

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Initially, this was the thing I resisted the most. Underhanded tactics and tricks... If this was not the only way to achieve a lasting peace, I would not be able to swallow this pill.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But the Sarkaz have been waiting for too long.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Among the countless wars, we must utilize this war, along with equally innumerable lives, to open up this world and understand its emotions.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Kal'tsit, Doctor, this will be the attitude I have towards you. We share the same beliefs, and we can complement each other. Therefore, I choose to respect the Doctor's choice.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Doctor, please tell me how you'd like this to end.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: This Sarkaz... He carried out an act of betrayal, not against me, but against an image of Theresa in his heart that had disappointed him.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: He cannot be called a traitor. As far as I can see, Her Majesty Theresa is willing to grant freedom to so many people—

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: —Why not exile this Sarkaz, and see what choices he makes?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Let him fend for himself upon this land.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: He may find a new faith, maybe in you, or someone else.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: —You... Why are you doing this...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm opposed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if the existing evidence does not prove his involvement with the Military Council, I do not deem it prudent to release a soldier who openly attacked his commander.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Y-Your Majesty...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Leave it to the army.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Yes, Marco, you are... a Sarkaz mercenary.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: So, Scout, take him to see Ascalon.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Babel will decide your fate. Ascalon will decide your fate.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: That you consider yourself a Sarkaz of Kazdel means you cannot leave.

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: —Your Majesty! You, you're putting me to death—?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Scout, before he has any outbursts of emotion, restrain—

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: ——No!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: No! No! No! You— You're right— That's right, kill me! You're doing the right thing, sending a flake like me to hell!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: —You were a war hero! To execute a traitor, a nobody like me, is what you should do!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Behave yourself!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: I was wrong... I was wrong. Your Majesty, you still have what we long for, the story we've heard for decades!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: The banner of the six heroes still flies. How many have grown up listening to the tales of you leading the Sarkaz against foreign invaders? The masses wait for that era to come again!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: I've been waiting— We've all been waiting!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: We're still waiting for those legends to reappear, waiting for that bloodstained history to reignite!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: That is what Sarkaz should be— that is what the Sarkaz must be!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Your Majesty! Now, this is justice. You have become justice!

steps.name: Sarkaz Traitor
steps.text: Your Majesty!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is the current situation. The mercenaries we've been able to contact will arrive in two days.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Whose team is it?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hoederer's.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Hoederer is an excellent commander, but he seems to despise war even more than he lets on.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will ensure that he arrives on time.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Good work, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Perhaps one day... the Sarkaz can finally escape meaningless conflict and sacrifice.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's sorrow written all over your face. Is it because of the incident with Marco?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: In him... I saw a microcosm.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The road ahead of us is still long, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's too long, Theresa. Such that your people want an answer, and they want it placed before them.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But you'll accompany me down that road, won't you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Of course...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That said, I heard you were doing some... fashion design last night?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Oh no, are you going to discipline me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, why would I? Proper relaxation is necessary for stress relief.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The situation isn't optimistic. Your every move will affect the morale of all Sarkaz.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Theresa.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Hm, Doctor, what's the matter?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Ascalon sends word that Marco committed suicide, out of fear of punishment...

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: In order to avoid embarrassing his King.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I... I know.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Doctor... What are you going to do next?

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: In addition to the mercenaries, all Sarkaz hiding under Kazdel's sphere of influence are paying close attention to our movements.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: This is a comprehensive relocation, and we have no margin of error when it comes to intelligence and logistics work.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Thank you... I'll speak with Ascalon later.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: She'll find good candidates.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Doctor...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Don't worry, I trust you.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Hopefully, the visions that I've seen will... No, rather, as long as we can still see, let us move forward a bit.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Doctor
steps.text: I've already gotten used to it.
